title: Unbounded Helson Forms with a Moment Representation
summary: We study the positive Helson form $h_0[a,b]=\sum_{m,n\ge1}α(mn)a_n\overline{b_m}$ on the finitely supported sequences $c_{00}\subset\ell^2(\mathbb{N})$, where $α(n)=\int_{\mathbb{R}}n^{-s}dμ(s)<\infty$ for a finite positive Borel measure $μ$. Under the Carleman condition $\sum_{k\ge1}α(4^k)^{-1/(2k)}=\infty$, closability of $h_0$ is equivalent to $\sqrt{n}α(n)\to0$, and hence to $μ((-\infty,1/2])=0$.
